  3 - Contains some inaccurate or out-of-date information making the response significantly less useful.
  4 - Contains key factual errors or outdated information.

So the clue “Rock on stage (C??IS)” resolves to **CHRIS**. Chris Rock is a well-known stand-up comedian who performs on stage and won his first Grammy Award in 1995.
